scripts.build: npm run stage:runtime && npx --yes @tauri-apps/cli@2.12.4 build --bundles app
scripts.check: npm run check:dependencies && npm run check:safe-types && npm run check:types && npm run check:lint && npm run check:unit && npm --workspace @aegis/agent run check && npm --workspace @aegis/app run check
scripts.check:types: npm run build:shared && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p app/tsconfig.react.json && tsc --noEmit -p checks/host/tsconfig.json
scripts.check:lint: oxlint --deny-warnings scripts packages checks/support checks/unit app/src/workspace app/src/platform app/src/cards app/src/main.tsx app/src/App.tsx app/src/composition.tsx app/src/canvas/Canvas.tsx app/src/canvas/CardPortals.tsx app/src/canvas/benchmark.ts vitest.config.ts app/src/charts app/src/editors/sheet app/src/editors/dataset app/src/features/data/*.ts app/src/features/data/*.tsx agent/src checks/host checks/mcp app/src/chrome/*.ts app/src/chrome/*.tsx app/src/editors/document app/src/editors/deck app/src/editors/object app/src/features/agents/*.ts app/src/features/agents/*.tsx app/src/features/settings/*.ts app/src/features/settings/*.tsx app/src/features/first-minute/*.tsx app/src/features/onboarding/*.tsx app/src/features/mobile/*.tsx app/src/features/editing/*.ts app/src/features/editing/*.tsx app/src/lib/native-files.ts
scripts.build:shared: tsc -p packages/domain/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.json && tsc -p agent/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/scene/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/host-client/tsconfig.json
